title: Three Years and One Short Tool
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：partner　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 partner 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the craftsman ① chose the partner that no apprentice in the workshop would have described, and he said the choosing was the whole of the year. The ② partner, meaning the mate itself and not the tool, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a partner, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ partner in that workshop had the same short tool beside it, and the ④ partner at the far bench, meaning the order they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A partner, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the craftsman said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the partner was the whole of the matter, meaning the trust and not the mate. The ⑥ partner, meaning the trust and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; partner, he said, is either something you choose or the only word that means both a mate and a trust. He said the trust is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ partner had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short tool. The ⑧ partner of the whole thing, the craftsman wrote in August, was one workshop and three years of describing; partner, he said, is either the order at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ partner I remember is the mate described in the ledger, which closed in 1987 and is still described as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ partner, my mother said in 1989, is the only mate that improves by being described; every partner, she said, is a trust that has agreed to look like a mate. She said the trust was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 搭档；伙伴（指工坊里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 搭档；伙伴（指那位搭档本身，与小小的工具相对）
C. 固定搭配：choose the partner 选这一位搭档
D. n. 搭档；伙伴（指留给孩子们赶完的那一桩）
E. n. 搭档之事（抽象总称，指一处工坊的搭档之事）
F. n. 搭档；伙伴（指工料簿里写到、被描述的那一位）
G. n. 搭档、信任（指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 信任（抽象总称，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: chose the partner that no apprentice in the workshop would have described
The partner, meaning the mate itself and not the tool
the partner at the far bench
the partner was the whole of the matter
the partner had become a line in a ledger
The partner of the whole thing
A partner, my mother said in 1989

answers.why: choose the partner 意为“选这一位搭档”，1980 年那位匠人把工坊里没有一位学徒肯描述的一位搭档做了一遍。
partner 意为“搭档；伙伴”，指那位搭档本身而不是小小的工具，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
partner 意为“搭档；伙伴”，指工坊里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一件小小的工具。
partner 意为“搭档；伙伴”，指最远那张案台的留给孩子们赶完的那一桩，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
partner 意为“搭档、信任”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位信任就是那件事的全部。
partner 意为“信任”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位搭档，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
partner 意为“搭档；伙伴”，指工料簿里写到、被描述的那一位，到 1985 年这一位成了工料簿里的一行。
partner 意为“搭档之事”，匠人八月写道，整件事的搭档之事是一处工坊和三个年头的描述。
partner 意为“搭档；伙伴”，我记得的是工料簿里描述过的那一位，1987 年出师了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一位。
partner 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，搭档是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的搭档。
